requirements.rule: Only the consolidated V6 specification is normative; older editions are historical evidence.
Every source, quote, page, cue and derived split has explicit provenance.
Future Boss Letter marks remain visually absent until their deciding step and rewind cleanly.
The six authentic note headings preserve task or listening-only classification across stage changes.
The authentic six-textarea page-3 sheet is the only note surface; learner text survives generation and remounts.
Exactly one controller owns playback, cue state, boundaries, transcript tracking and note transactions.
Legacy polling, synthetic worksheets, duplicate marker layers and silent alternate runtimes are prohibited.
The player has one timeline, one pin layer, exactly 17 pins and a visibility-consistent labelled toggle.
Elapsed time, total time, speed, retry state and cue provenance remain readable at supported viewports.
Every cue has stable ID, semantic start, endpoint, destination, text, task and source turn.
A cue transaction is atomic and writes only when cue, playhead, endpoint and field agree.
Replay, seeking and stale-state repair use semantic cue intervals and never duplicate generated notes.
Every transcript utterance preserves separate speaker and copy elements through listening and review.
The active utterance is visibly highlighted and follows playback unless the learner disables follow mode.
A rejection line crosses rejected copy only, never the speaker label.
Transcript move, resize, translation, follow and fit controls preserve readable geometry.
At a cue boundary, source utterance, evidence panel and destination textarea are visibly connected.
Listening reports 1/17 through 17/17 and transcript review reports its own separate counter.
Every runtime sentence has one primary type; the contact sentence is Type 5 and the rumours sentence is separate Type 6.
Multi-task headings use readable Task A and Task B badges or Task A + Task B, never slash-only shorthand.
Task colour remains on the full model sentence while nested syntax words retain purple.
Every reveal, route, typewriter, strike, focus and source-preview transition has a persistent reduced-motion equivalent.
Persisted state is versioned, validated, migrated or safely reset; learner-authored content is never discarded.
Three native remounts create no duplicate IDs, listeners, panels, pins or controls and lose no notes.
Controls, states, task meanings and cue progress remain keyboard and screen-reader accessible without colour dependence.
Player, transcript, dock, evidence bank and active field remain usable without overlap at desktop, mobile and zoomed viewports.
Production scripts under test must not be replaced or mocked in a way that hides their behaviour.
Focused CI executes static, Chromium, Firefox, real-audio and visual evidence gates before deployment.
Publication is incomplete until release.json and the cache-busted runtime expose the intended SHA and V6 handshake.
Every conforming release archives screenshots, cue logs, browser results, workflow URL, SHA and approved variances.
